    Come on, you guys!  According to the last two lisp
    recents, (POP X) returns (CAR X) in the interpreter,
    but (CDR X) in the compiler!!!  And how about clarifying
    how one overrides these with ones own (presumably more
    consistent) definitions?  Thanks, Mark
--------
Unfourtunatly, after the compiler was released, we decided that (CAR X) was
more apprpriate...I suspect this change will be reflected in the compiler
shortly.
